The term "NDC distributor" can refer to [NDC Distributors](https://ndcdrug.com/), a national wholesale distributor of generic pharmaceuticals based in Cranbury, New Jersey, or to member distributors associated with [NDC, Inc.](https://ndc-inc.com/), a major U.S. healthcare master distributor based in Nashville, Tennessee, that supplies medical-surgical consumables. [](https://ndcdrug.com/who-we-are)

- **Focus:** Specializes in generic prescription drugs and pharmaceuticals.

- **Operations:** Licensed across all 50 states, serving retail pharmacies, long-term care facilities, hospitals, and specialty clinics.

- **Compliance:** Accredited by the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP) and compliant with the Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)

[](https://ndcdrug.com/)

### NDC, Inc. (Healthcare Master Distributor)

- **Focus:** Acts as a master middleman connecting medical supply manufacturers with smaller, regional healthcare distributors.

- **Markets:** Supplies products for primary care, acute care, dental, physical therapy, home care, and veterinary fields.

- **Role:** Helps regional distributors efficiently access tens of thousands of medical products without needing direct manufacturer contracts. [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/national-distribution-contracting)
